blindness_policy: Participant inputs define analysis questions and eligibility rules; reference selections and pooled values are distributed separately.
candidate_subgroup_policy: Candidate subgroup questions simulate prospective user requests. The agent must use only protocol and extracted source fields to decide whether a question is feasible, insufficiently supported, or should be blocked; it must not manufacture a result.
